name: table
useFor: Use for rows of records people scan and act on (mailboxes, agents and lines, webhooks). Put labels in TableHeader, rows in TableBody, totals in a TableFooter and Pagination with bar under the table; row actions are ghost icon buttons in the last cell. Pass variant open for a list that sits on its own (a clear head and rows that wash on hover). Keep cells to one line; truncate long values.
constraints: A dark or purple head row
source: Console src/components/table/PaginatedTable.tsx (TABLE_SX and the open table)
